description: Energy System Technology Data is a PyPSA-maintained script collection that compiles assumptions for energy-system modelling. It merges technology costs, efficiencies, lifetimes and related parameters from multiple sources into CSV tables. Outputs standardise cost years, technology names and units and retain source information. Users choose target years, with 2020, 2030 and 2050 given as examples, and can add technologies through the documented workflow. Coverage is technology-level, not an asset map; geographic applicability depends on each underlying source and there is no common spatial resolution. The public Python code in the scripts directory is free under GPL-3.0-only. The README explicitly warns that separate licences and terms may apply to input data, so the code licence must not be interpreted as a blanket licence for all source tables. This record identifies the reusable compiler, with compiled CSV outputs as its products. It supplies planning assumptions to energy-system simulations and scenario comparisons. The repository names PyPSA-Eur (model-pypsa-eur) and PyPSA-Earth as users of its outputs; external source assumptions and their currency still need checking for each study.
